name: Redcap Gutter-Dweller
oracle: As Redcap Gutter-Dweller enters, choose a color. Redcap Gutter-Dweller is the chosen color in addition to its other colors. Whenever Redcap Gutter-Dweller attacks, create a red Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.") Goblins you control have menace as long as Redcap Gutter-Dweller has three or more counters on it.
